page_title: ATA 2-3 NAP | Atalanta v Napoli 18/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
88' Scott McTominay (Napoli) unnecessarily kicks the ball off the pitch. Scott McTominay (Napoli) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
85' The referee is firm and issues Isak Hien (Atalanta) a deserved yellow card. Isak Hien (Atalanta) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
84' Substitution. Romelu Lukaku leaves the pitch and is replaced by Giovanni Simeone (Napoli).
83' Gian Piero Gasperini prepares a substitution. Giorgio Scalvini is replaced by Marco Brescianini (Atalanta).
82' That's the end of the game for Matteo Politano, who is replaced by Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli).
81' The corner from Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) is hurriedly cleared.

78' 2 - 3 Frank Anguissa sends a superb cross into the box. Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) latches on to it and from close range plants a header into the bottom right corner, leaving Marco Carnesecchi beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 2:3.
78' Nicolo Zaniolo (Atalanta) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
77' Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
77' Substitution. Nicolo Zaniolo (Atalanta) on for Ademola Lookman.
77' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to make a change. Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) replaces Lazar Samardzic.
76' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
74' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
73' A substitution has been made. David Neres goes off and Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli) comes on.
73' Antonio Conte isn't happy on the touchline after referee Andrea Colombo shows him a yellow card.
70' Alex Meret makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the right-hand post by Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) after a cross from the side.
68' Gian Piero Gasperini decides to make a substitution. Matteo Ruggeri will be replaced by Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta).
68' The game has come to an end for Mateo Retegui. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta).
67' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
66' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Matteo Ruggeri (Atalanta) was quite harsh and Andrea Colombo didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
65' Matteo Politano (Napoli) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
64' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
63' The cross into the penalty area from Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
61' Scott McTominay (Napoli) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
59' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) makes a run into the box and gets on the end of a cross, but his well-taken shot crashes into a defender and is cleared away.
59' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) takes the corner with a short pass.
59' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Good work from Atalanta as they win a corner.
59' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

58' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the left side of the goal. However, Alex Meret anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save. The referee blows his whistle, Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.
55' 2 - 2 Goal! Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the right post. He makes it 2:2.
53' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance!
53' Some neat passing and movement from Atalanta as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
50' The ball is cleared after Ederson (Atalanta) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
49' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
48' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
47' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
42' David Neres (Napoli) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
40' 1 - 2 Goal! Frank Anguissa shows great vision to find Scott McTominay (Napoli) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the roof of the net. 1:2.
38' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
37' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
36' David Neres (Napoli) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
34' The total number of attempts is 5:3. The shots on goal statistics – 2:1.
33' A fine solo run by Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) takes him deep into the box, but it comes to nothing as his shot flies well wide of the left post.
32' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle and it's Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
29' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post.
27' 1 - 1 Goal! Matteo Politano (Napoli) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top of the net. He makes it 1:1.
25' Matteo Politano (Napoli) will take the corner.
25' David Neres (Napoli) and Romelu Lukaku attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.

23' David Neres (Napoli) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Marco Carnesecchi anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the bottom left corner.
23' Ederson (Atalanta) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alex Meret intercepts the ball.
22' What a miskick by Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
22' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.

20' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. Alex Meret guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
20' Scott McTominay (Napoli) tries to find David Neres, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
16' 1 - 0 Goal! Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top of the net. He makes it 1:0.
14' Ederson (Atalanta) struck the ball which rebounded to the edge of the box. His attempt went narrowly over the crossbar.
13' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
11' Matteo Politano (Napoli) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the right post.
7' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
4' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
3' Andrea Colombo blows his whistle as Ederson (Atalanta) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
2' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
1' The first half has started.
Napoli will kick-off.
